metadata.question: Does cloud cover increase in Western Australia (specifically (-20.59, 125.93)) between 11:00 and 14:00 local time on January 14, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Terra (MOD09GA) and Aqua (MYD09GA) daily surface reflectance QA (state_1km) over a 10 km buffer around the point (-20.59, 125.93). Filter by UTC windows corresponding to AWST (UTC+8): earlier window near 11:00 AWST (03:00–04:00Z, with fallback 02:00–04:00Z) and later window near 14:00 AWST (05:00–06:30Z, with fallback 05:00–07:00Z). 2. Masking strategy: Do not mask clouds; instead, decode state_1km QA bits (0–1) to classify cloudy (values 1 or 2) vs. clear. Count valid pixels vs. cloudy pixels to compute cloud fraction. 3. Logic for valid vs. null/error: If collection size is 0 for either window after fallback, output C1. If valid pixel count is 0, output C2. If computed fraction is null/NaN/out of [0,1], output C3. Otherwise compare later vs earlier to decide A or B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([125.93, -20.59]); const region = pt.buffer(10000); // 10 km // AWST (UTC+8): 11:00–14:00 on 2020-01-14 -> UTC windows const earlyStart = '2020-01-14T03:00:00Z'; const earlyEnd = '2020-01-14T04:00:00Z'; const earlyFallbackStart = '2020-01-14T02:00:00Z'; const earlyFallbackEnd = '2020-01-14T04:00:00Z'; const lateStart = '2020-01-14T05:00:00Z'; const lateEnd = '2020-01-14T06:30:00Z'; const lateFallbackEnd = '2020-01-14T07:00:00Z'; // Helper to get first image from collection with window and bounds function getModisImage(collectionId, start, end) { return ee.ImageCollection(collectionId) .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(region) .select(['state_1km']) .sort('system:time_start') .first(); } // Try earlier (near 11:00 AWST) with Terra let earlyCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD09GA') .filterDate(earlyStart, earlyEnd) .filterBounds(region) .select(['state_1km']); let earlySize = await earlyCol.size().getInfo(); let earlyFallbackUsed = false; if (earlySize === 0) { earlyCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD09GA') .filterDate(earlyFallbackStart, earlyFallbackEnd) .filterBounds(region) .select(['state_1km']) .sort('system:time_start'); earlySize = await earlyCol.size().getInfo(); earlyFallbackUsed = earlySize > 0; } if (earlySize === 0) { console.log('Early window images (Terra): 0'); console.log('Later window images (Aqua): TBD'); console.log('C1: Empty Collection'); console.log('C1'); return; } const earlyImg = ee.Image(earlyCol.first()); // Try later (near 14:00 AWST) with Aqua let lateCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD09GA') .filterDate(lateStart, lateEnd) .filterBounds(region) .select(['state_1km']) .sort('system:time_start'); let lateSize = await lateCol.size().getInfo(); let lateFallbackUsed = false; if (lateSize === 0) { lateCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD09GA') .filterDate(lateStart, lateFallbackEnd) .filterBounds(region) .select(['state_1km']) .sort('system:time_start'); lateSize = await lateCol.size().getInfo(); lateFallbackUsed = lateSize > 0; } if (lateSize === 0) { console.log(`Early window images (Terra): ${earlySize}${earlyFallbackUsed ? ' (fallback used)' : ''}`); console.log('Later window images (Aqua): 0'); console.log('C1: Empty Collection'); console.log('C1'); return; } const lateImg = ee.Image(lateCol.first()); // Function to compute cloud stats from state_1km async function cloudStats(img, label) { // Decode cloud state: bits 0-1 (0=clear, 1=cloudy, 2=mixed, 3=not set) const qa = img.select('state_1km'); const cloudState = qa.bitwiseAnd(3); const cloudy = cloudState.eq(1).or(cloudState.eq(2)).updateMask(qa.mask()); const validCount = await qa.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('state_1km').getInfo(); const cloudCount = await cloudy.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('state_1km').getInfo(); const timeUTC = await ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm').getInfo(); const timeLocal = await ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).advance(8, 'hour').format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm').getInfo(); return { valid: validCount || 0, cloudy: cloudCount || 0, frac: (validCount && cloudCount != null) ? (cloudCount / validCount) : null, timeUTC, timeLocal, label }; } const early = await cloudStats(earlyImg, 'Terra'); const late = await cloudStats(lateImg, 'Aqua'); // Check C2: No valid pixels if (early.valid === 0 || late.valid === 0) { console.log(`Early window images (Terra): ${earlySize}${earlyFallbackUsed ? ' (fallback used)' : ''}`); console.log(`Later window images (Aqua): ${lateSize}${lateFallbackUsed ? ' (fallback used)' : ''}`); console.log('No valid pixels after QA decoding.'); console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Validate fractions const invalidEarly = (early.frac === null) || isNaN(early.frac) || early.frac < 0 || early.frac > 1; const invalidLate = (late.frac === null) || isNaN(late.frac) || late.frac < 0 || late.frac > 1; if (invalidEarly || invalidLate) { console.log(`Early Img Time (AWST): ${early.timeLocal}, Valid: ${early.valid}, CloudPx: ${early.cloudy}`); console.log(`Late Img Time (AWST): ${late.timeLocal}, Valid: ${late.valid}, CloudPx: ${late.cloudy}`); console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (invalid cloud fraction)'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Print concise evidence console.log(`Early window images (Terra): ${earlySize}${earlyFallbackUsed ? ' (fallback used)' : ''}`); console.log(`Late window images (Aqua): ${lateSize}${lateFallbackUsed ? ' (fallback used)' : ''}`); console.log(`Terra @ ${early.timeLocal} AWST (UTC ${early.timeUTC})`); console.log(` - Cloud%: ${(early.frac * 100).toFixed(1)} | Valid px: ${early.valid}`); console.log(`Aqua @ ${late.timeLocal} AWST (UTC ${late.timeUTC})`); console.log(` - Cloud%: ${(late.frac * 100).toFixed(1)} | Valid px: ${late.valid}`); // 5. Final Answer if (late.frac > early.frac) { console.log('A: Yes'); } else { console.log('B: No'); } } catch (err) { console.error('D: Processing error', err); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
